aro.line: You close your eyes to look aro—
stanza: It's not a place
This country is to me a sound
Of drum and bass
You close your eyes to look aro—

sorrow.line: Far from the twisted reach of crazy sorrow
stanza: And take me disappearing through the smoke rings of my mind
Down the foggy ruins of time, far past the frozen leaves
The haunted, frightened trees, out to the windy beach
Far from the twisted reach of crazy sorrow
Yes, to dance beneath the diamond sky with one hand waving free
Silhouetted by the sea, circled by the circus sands
With all memory and fate driven deep beneath the waves
Let me forget about today until tomorrow

sorrow.songTitle: Fly Around My Pretty Little Miss
sorrow.line: I'd fly away from sorrow
stanza: If I had a snow white ship
I'd sail away tomorrow
If I had a silver sail
I'd fly away from sorrow

sorrow.line: And their hearts were filled with sorrow
stanza: They were strolling in the gloaming
Where the roses were in bloom
A soldier and his sweetheart brave and true
And their hearts were filled with sorrow
For their thoughts were of tomorrow
As she pinned a rose upon his coat of blue

sorrow.line: And sometimes there'll be sorrow
stanza: Just a little green
Like the color when the spring is born
There'll be crocuses to bring to school tomorrow
Just a little green
Like the nights when the Northern lights perform
There'll be icicles and birthday clothes
And sometimes there'll be sorrow

sorrow.line: We dance the sorrow
stanza: Darling, I loved you
I long to become you
And know what it is that you gave
We dance the sorrow
Forgive me tomorrow
I pray

sorrow.line: Going home without my sorrow
stanza: Going home without my sorrow
Going home sometime tomorrow
Going home to where it's better
Than before

sorrow.line: This much madness is too much sorrow
stanza: You take my hand, I'll take your hand
Together, we may get away
This much madness is too much sorrow
It's impossible to make it today

sorrow.line: I'd rather breathe than drown in sorrow
stanza: Don't you care
That it may seem unfair?
You steal things you ought to borrow
Don't you find
That it may seem unkind?
I'd rather breathe than drown in sorrow

sorrow.line: You confronted your sorrow
stanza: Just some Portland white trash
You confronted your sorrow
Like there was no tomorrow
While the rest of the world only laughed

sorrow.line: 'Cause I know you're living in sorrow
stanza: I've waited all through the years, love
To give you a heart true and real
'Cause I know you're living in sorrow
In your loveless mansion on the hill

sorrow.songTitle: You Don’t Care for Me Enough to Cry
sorrow.line: I'm so damn good at sorrow
stanza: So here's to hoping I can change tomorrow
You wanted hard as nails cut and dry
But I beg, steal and borrow
I'm so damn good at sorrow
And you don't care for me enough to cry

sorrow.line: No more agony, please, no more sorrow
stanza: Shut up and count some sheep
Do me a favor and don't bitch in your sleep
No more agony, please, no more sorrow

sorrow.songTitle: Speed of the Sound of Loneliness
sorrow.line: It's a mighty mean and a dreadful sorrow
stanza: It's a mighty mean and a dreadful sorrow
It's crossed the evil line today
Well, how can you ask about tomorrow
When we ain't got one word to say

sorrow.line: But through my sorrow
stanza: Oh, my brother, you've gone before me
And how I long to be with you
But through my sorrow
As I remain here
There is only one thing that I can do

sorrow.line: There’s bound to be talk tomorrow (Think of my lifelong sorrow)
sorrow.linePrev: But don’t you see (How can you do this thing to me)
sorrow.lineNext: At least there will be plenty implied (If you caught pneumonia and died)

sorrow.line: But her singing brings me sorrow
stanza: Well, the lady's been told that all the gold
Is worth so much it can't be sold
No time to weep, she'll need her sleep tomorrow
When she carries her face to the market place
And bets it on the opening race
She can ring her bells, Miss Carousel
But her singing brings me sorrow

sorrow.line: We all have sorrow
stanza: Sometimes in our lives, we all have pain
We all have sorrow
But if we are wise
We know that there's always tomorrow

sorrow.songTitle: I’ll Never Fall in Love Again
sorrow.line: You only get lies and pain and sorrow
stanza: What do you get when you fall in lovе?
You only get lies and pain and sorrow
So for at least until tomorrow

sorrow.line: When I think of all my sorrow
stanza: No, I can't forget tomorrow
When I think of all my sorrow
When I had you there, but then I let you go
And now it's only fair that I should let you know
What you should know

sorrow.line: It fills me with sorrow (It fills me with sorrow)
sorrow.linePrev: When I look at the world (When I look at the world)

sorrow.line: Tomorrow may rain with sorrow
stanza: Tomorrow may rain with sorrow
Here's a little time we can borrow
Forget all our troubles in these moments so few
All we've got right now, the only thing that, all that we really have to do
Is have ourselves a heavenly day
Lay here and watch the trees sway
Oh, can't see no other way, no way, no way
Heavenly day, heavenly day, heavenly day

sorrow.line: I hope you hear inside my voice of sorrow
stanza: I hope you hear inside my voice of sorrow
And that it motivates you to make a better tomorrow
This place is cruel, nowhere could be much colder
If we don't change, the world will soon be over
Living just enough, stop giving just enough for the city

sorrow.line: Or be spared the sorrow
stanza: We tell tales to be known
Or be spared the sorrow
You're so fair to behold
What will be left when you're gone?
And it shakes everything you know
How we were when the waters were low
Southern winds, scattered clouds from the cove
And, oh, oh, oh, oh, spare me the glow

sorrow.songTitle: Mama, You Been on My Mind (Studio Outtake - 1993)
sorrow.line: Where you've been don't bother me, or bring me down in sorrow
stanza: Even though my eyes are hazy and my thoughts they might be narrow
Where you've been don't bother me, or bring me down in sorrow
I don't even mind who you'll be waking with tomorrow
But mama, you're just on my mind

sorrow.line: Our morals are out of place and got our lives full of sorrow
sorrow.linePrev: The question was rhetorical, the answer is horrible
sorrow.lineNext: And so, tomorrow comin' later than usual

sorrow.line: I wear my own crown of sadness and sorrow
sorrow.linePrev: I would lick your feet, but is that the sickest move?
sorrow.lineNext: And who'd have thought tomorrow would be so strange?

sorrow.line: I try to drive away my sorrow
stanza: (Verse 3)
Massa made de darkeys love him
'Cause he was so kind
Now de sadly weep above him
Mourning 'cause he leave dem behind
I cannot work before tomorrow
'Cause de tear drops flow
I try to drive away my sorrow
Pickin' on de old banjo

sorrow.line: Swallowing sorrow
It only brings me sorrow
stanza: Oh, how can, how can you ask me again?
It only brings me sorrow
The same thing I would want today
I would want again tomorrow

sorrow.line: And I'll see what you've chained to your sorrow
stanza: There's an attic where children are playing
Where I've got to lie down with you soon
In a dream of Hungarian lanterns
In the mist of some sweet afternoon
And I'll see what you've chained to your sorrow
All your sheep and your lilies of snow

sorrow.line: Will you bring me sorrow?
stanza: Where are you going now, my love?
Where will you be tomorrow?
Will you bring me happiness?
Will you bring me sorrow?

sorrow.line: I want to save you from your sorrow
stanza: Should I tear my eyes out now?
Everything I see returns to you, somehow
Should I tear my heart out now?
Everything I feel returns to you, somehow
I want to save you from your sorrow

sorrow.line: Chain of sorrow
stanza: For a heart stained in anger grows weak and grows bitter
You'll become your own prisoner as you watch yourself sit there
Wrapped up in a trap of your very own
Chain of sorrow

sorrow.songTitle: I Guess the Lord Must Be in New York City
sorrow.line: I'll say goodbye to all my sorrow
stanza: I'll say goodbye to all my sorrow
And by tomorrow, I'll be on my way
I guess the Lord must be in New York City
I'm so tired of getting nowhere
Seein' my prayers goin' unanswered
I guess the Lord must be in New York City

sorrow.line: He saw every kind of sorrow
stanza: The passageway was narrow
There was blackness in the air
He saw every kind of sorrow
Heard voices everywhere

sorrow.line: Behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto His sorrow
stanza: AIR. (Tenor)
Behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto His sorrow
